summary: Nordisk Bergteknik AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, provides rock handling, foundation work, and mining services for the infrastructure, construction, and mining industries in Sweden, Norway, Finland, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Rock Sweden, Rock Norway, and Foundation Sweden. The company offers foundation works, foundation reinforcement, sheet piling, soil reinforcement, transport and excavation, drilling and excavation, rock crushing, mining and prospect drilling, rock reinforcement, concrete rehabilitation, rock splitting, foundation construction, grounding, groundwater lowering, wire sawing, rock stabilization, and foundation reinforcement services. It also provides rock excavation, rock fracturing, concrete spraying, piling, grouting, and soil nailing services. The company's services are used in local and national infrastructure, construction projects and contracts, wind farms, mines, natural environments, and other applications. Nordisk Bergteknik AB (publ) was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.
